Volumes in Calabi-Yau Complete Intersection of Products of Projective Space

Yi-Heng Tsai

Abstract. We prove that the birational automorphism group of a general Calabi-yau complete intersection X given by ample divisors in pr x ... × pm is always Lorentzain. Applying the Kawamata-Morrison cone theorem on such X, we compute volx (D + sA) for any divisor D € JEff(X) and ample divisor A when s is small. We also provide examples of volumes of certain Cartier divisors that involve the digamma function.
